$comment: Tenant-classification registry — machine-readable form of docs/multi-university.md §3. Every BASE TABLE in schema `public` MUST have an entry; supabase/tests/tenant_registry.test.sql fails the build otherwise. Classes: A = university-scoped root (has university_id + RESTRICTIVE tenant_isolation policy on current_university_id()); B = child scoped via parent FK (RESTRICTIVE tenant_isolation EXISTS(<parent>) policy; declare `parent`); C = user-owned (policy quals reference auth.uid(); tenant scope = owner's profile); D = social graph (mechanism `confined` = RESTRICTIVE tenant_confined INSERT policy, `membership` = reads gated by participant/membership of a confined parent — declare `reason`); E/F = exempt (city-infra / platform-global; declare `reason`). Adding a table? Pick a class per docs/multi-university.md and add the entry in the same PR as the migration.

ad_campaigns.reason: advertiser B2B surface; owner/superadmin policies, university_id is the ad target dimension not a student-tenant boundary

ad_creatives.reason: advertiser B2B surface; scoped through ad_campaigns ownership

ad_impressions.reason: ad event log; RLS default-deny (service-role only) is intentional

admin_audit_log.reason: platform admin audit trail; superadmin/service surface, default-deny to app roles

admin_email_log.reason: cron dedup log for admin digest/nudge emails; RLS default-deny (service-role only) is intentional

admin_invitations.reason: platform admin RBAC invitations; not campus content

advertiser_invitations.reason: superadmin-issued B2B invitations; the signup-gate exception reads it via SECURITY DEFINER

advertisers.reason: B2B accounts outside the student tenant model; owner + superadmin policies

amazon_product_variations.reason: variant rows (color/size/count) of the platform-global amazon_products catalog; public read, admin-only writes, no university_id — same platform-global scope as its parent

analytics_events.reason: platform-global analytics; university_id may later become a dashboard dimension, not a boundary

api_rate_limits.reason: platform infra; RLS default-deny (no policies) is intentional

blocked_users.reason: user-pair rows readable only by the involved users (auth.uid() quals); no cross-tenant pairs can form under the confined social graph

broadcast_templates.reason: superadmin announcement templates; RLS default-deny (service-role only), CRUD via api/admin/broadcast-templates.ts

bus_stops.reason: Pittsburgh city infrastructure, not university data; needs city/campus notion only when a non-Pittsburgh tenant lands

campus_dining_menus.reason: Class A for the same reason as campus_laundry_machines — own university_id, direct isolation; the location FK is cascade only.

campus_ingest_runs.reason: Class A. Operational heartbeat for the campus_* ingest, readable by authenticated users so the UI can show data age instead of implying freshness it cannot verify.

campus_laundry_machines.reason: Class A rather than B: carries its own university_id so the RESTRICTIVE tenant_isolation policy applies directly, matching every other table in migration 20261004000000. The FK to campus_laundry_rooms is for cascade delete, not for tenant scope.

content_reports.reason: platform moderation surface; superadmin-only (SELECT/UPDATE/DELETE gate on is_superadmin) — university_admins read via the tenant-clamped get_content_reports RPC, never the base table

conversations.reason: tenant_confined INSERT still requires both participants in one university, OR both in universities sharing a marketplace_group (20260918000000). Consent is unchanged and is NOT carried by this policy: conversations.status + initiated_by and rls_conversations_insert_privacy_gate still make every DM a request the recipient accepts. Without this a shared listing is visible but its seller is uncontactable.

deleted_accounts.reason: platform account-lifecycle log; RLS default-deny is intentional

dm_poll_votes.reason: reads and writes are gated by the parent message conversation participants; vote writes also bind user_id to auth.uid() and option_index to the message's poll metadata

email_suppressions.reason: Resend bounce/complaint suppression list for broadcast mail; RLS default-deny (service-role only) is intentional

group_conversations.reason: reads gated by group_members, whose INSERT is tenant_confined

group_message_reactions.reason: reads gated by is_chat_group_member of the parent group_message (same predicate as group_messages); INSERT/DELETE require user_id = auth.uid()

group_messages.reason: reads gated by group_members, whose INSERT is tenant_confined

marketplace_alerts.reason: university_id column is a dimension (server-derived match scope), not a tenant boundary — rows are owner-scoped (user_id = auth.uid()).

marketplace_listings.reason: Class A with an ASYMMETRIC policy since 20260918000000: USING widens to universities.shares_marketplace() (co-located schools in the same marketplace_group — Pitt/CMU/Carlow), while WITH CHECK stays pinned to current_university_id(). Read across the group, write only into your own school. The qual still names current_university_id() so the class-A audit keeps covering it. Children marketplace_listing_items and listing_verifications are class B via EXISTS on this table and follow automatically.

message_reactions.reason: reads gated by the parent message's conversation participants (same predicate as messages); INSERT/DELETE require user_id = auth.uid()

messages.reason: reads gated by conversation participants; conversations INSERT is tenant_confined

moderation_actions.reason: platform moderation surface; superadmin-only (INSERT/SELECT gate on is_superadmin)

movein_push_log.reason: cron idempotency log for move-in countdown pushes; RLS default-deny (service-role only) is intentional

notifications.reason: university_id column is a dimension, not a tenant boundary — rows are recipient-scoped (user_id = auth.uid()). Do not add a tenant policy.

pogoh_station.reason: Pittsburgh city infrastructure, not university data; needs city/campus notion only when a non-Pittsburgh tenant lands

profiles_public.reason: Read-only projection of profiles (identity: name/avatar), written only by the definer sync trigger. SELECT policy is own-row OR tenant-scoped via current_university_id() (IS DISTINCT FROM semantics) OR superadmin — deliberately no is_public opt-out: identity must resolve for DM senders. Since 20260918000000 it also resolves for shares_marketplace(university_id): without that, every cross-school listing in the shared marketplace renders from a faceless seller, which is worse for safety than showing who you are dealing with.

profiles_roommate.reason: Read-only projection of profiles (roommate discovery columns), written only by the definer sync trigger. SELECT policy mirrors the historical roommate_profiles view WHERE exactly: (is_public OR own row) AND (own row OR tenant match, NULLs matching).

push_broadcasts.reason: platform admin broadcast audit trail; superadmin read, service-role writes

school_directory.reason: pre-tenant reference data; RLS default-deny (service-role read) is intentional

school_domains.reason: email domains per directory school; platform-global reference, read only via resolve_school_by_domain(); never authorizes sign-in

schools.reason: US institution reference directory (IPEDS spine) powering waitlist school naming; platform-global, never authorizes sign-in

seller_ratings.reason: Tenant is the SELLER's university. Resolved via the SECURITY DEFINER helper profile_university(seller_id), not an inline EXISTS over profiles: an inline EXISTS runs as the invoker and inherits profiles' own-row-only RLS, so it is false for every seller except yourself (2026-08-02).

universities.reason: the tenant registry itself; writes are service-role only

university_admin_leads.reason: B2B lead capture, exists ahead of a tenant

university_waitlist.reason: public demand capture ahead of a tenant existing; INSERT-only for app roles
